bio: The natural light and high ceilings are the first things to catch your eye when you walk into Asian Glories, but it is the view of the church and the canal that really wins you over. Understated Asian art lends a touch of individuality to the decor. The open kitchen affords glimpses of hanging Peking ducks and busy chefs at work. The culinary traditions of Canton and Sichuan prevail here, served up in generous, umami-rich dishes. Dim sum, prepared in house, chicken tempura, a beautifully light and airy steamed bun with pork belly confit: good luck choosing from the extensive à la carte and set menus!...
